d: Namaste, Mahindra just announced its XUV 3XO ZNG, its first-ever CNG SUV. Starting at Rs 9.99 lakh ex-showroom, it will rival the similarly priced Suzuki Brezza and Tata Nexon iCNG. Only one drivetrain option will be on sale: the 1.2L Turbo MPFi engine, but interestingly, power figures have not dropped on CNG, and it continues to give the same 114.5ps at 5000 rpm and 200 nm.
